items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: I really wasn't so much interested in him... I know the boy that I speak of that played with us used to work with him and he used to have he used to hear him play baritone

ctx.x: And that's where Lewis Neasle or Pat Neasle what used to play with us and loint with us with the American brass band that's why Pat Neasle wanted to play baritone because he heard Miller play and he said that instrument sounded so good to me he said when Miller used to play he used to play at the shop sometimes you know practice parts because he had his instrument there he was a goldsmith and uh houseman I think was the name of the firm that uh I don't know if they're still in that business yet or not
Yeah I think they're still in the business.
